title: review: P2b fix round 2: when executor runs for a fix task, every status, hold_reason, resume_hint and failure update targets the fix task id (never the parent), parent bookkeeping stays limited to codex_thread, codex_thread_head and rounds on an actual resume, and tests drive the real reply() through simulated usage-limit and rounds-exhausted events with fix_round_task_id set (review T-0480)
spec:
Fix round 2 for T-0466 (P2b), addressing review T-0480 (three findings) on task/T-0466 at cd91054. Work only in your own worktree and commit only on your own branch (git branch --show-current must print your task id); never write into another worktree.
1. executor._run and executor.reply: introduce one helper, e.g. _state_target(task) -> task.get("_run_task_id", task["id"]), and use it for every bus.update that sets status, hold_reason, reason, resume_hint or result on a usage limit (executor.py around 140: status held "codex usage limit; resets in N min"), on an argv error (around 124), on reply()'s early returns (refused, incompatible) and on the rounds-exhausted failure (around 354: "fix loop exceeded MAX_ROUNDS rounds"); when running for a fix task these land on the fix task, and the parent keeps its own status and hold_reason. Parent updates are limited to codex_thread, codex_thread_head and rounds, and only after an actual resume attempt started. Add a docstring on reply() stating the contract.
2. Tests, exercising the real reply()/_run() with the codex subprocess mocked (the existing argv/_run mocking pattern in tests/test_executor.py): test_reply_usage_limit_holds_fix_task_not_parent (mock a usage-limit outcome; the fix task is held with the codex usage limit reason; the parent's status and hold_reason are unchanged), test_reply_rounds_exhausted_fails_fix_task_not_parent (parent rounds at MAX_ROUNDS at call time; the fix task fails with the exceeded reason; the parent status unchanged), test_reply_argv_error_resume_hint_on_fix_task; tests/test_daemon.py: strengthen test_reply_worker_handles_held_requeues_fix_task_for_retry to assert the parent's status and hold_reason are unchanged after the held outcome (keep the existing assertions).
Keep every T-0466 test and existing tests green; full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exit 0; commit in your worktree with the task id including every named test; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: tests/test_daemon.py::test_reply_worker_handles_held_requeues_fix_task_for_retry asserts the parent's status and hold_reason unchanged and passes
no bus.update in executor targets the parent's status, hold_reason, reason or resume_hint while running for a fix task; parent updates are limited to codex_thread, codex_thread_head and rounds
all T-0466 tests and existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree; the commit is on this task's own branch

comments.issue: resume_plan(parent, fix_task) never reads fix_task; the parameter is dead beyond call-site bookkeeping in tests. Harmless but confusing — either use it (e.g. for fix-task-specific policy) or drop it.
